//catalogue: path is the API's category id: 9672 is MEN (MEN + UNISEX products, what the site's men section shows), from result.aggregations.tree.genders. The API ignores genderId=men. label goes into push titles. Run --dump to see the catalogue.
//sizes: Only stock in these sizes makes a push: a sale or price drop with none of them in stock is just logged. Matched by the size's name as the site shows it. Products without these sizes (waist-sized trousers) never push.
//notify: Your ntfy topic is SECRET (it is the only password on free ntfy.sh) -> set NTFY_TOPIC in the .env file, NOT here. Optionally override the server with NTFY_SERVER.

notify.//dailyHour: Send one quiet (min priority) check-in push per day at/after this hour (local time; set TZ in docker-compose). It is the proof-of-life heartbeat. -1 disables.
notify.//failureAlertHours: If every check fails for this long, push one warning (reset on the next good check).

//watch: After each check the tracker writes next-run (unix seconds) = now + intervalMinutes +/- jitterSeconds, or the next wakeAt local time (HH:MM) if that is sooner. Uniqlo India starts sale prices at 02:00 IST (Tuesdays so far), so 02:01 catches them within a minute. One check is 7 API pages of 100 products plus one stock call per sale listing (~130).
